lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity local maxima are organized into approximately four primary horizontal rows and at least ten vertical columns, forming a semi-regular grid of roughly circular pixel clusters posterior to the gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like coordinate system across the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal edge and a defined shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a significantly higher spatial density of smaller high-luminance blobs compared to the primary lateral flank patterning.
